BiblicalUsage: Keraz is the Aramaic word to proclaim, to cry out. Daniel 5:29 says Belshazzar made a proclamation concerning Daniel, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the king's proclamation came too late to save him, but Daniel's God had already written the true verdict on the wall.
